name: Terrarium 35x25x28
label: Small terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 35x25x28 cm. Volume: 24.5 liters, horizontal format. A clean glass space with decorative film on the outside that helps the terrarium blend into your home. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 35x25x28 cm terrarium has no 3D background, so all 25 cm of depth is available to the animal. The floor is 875 cm², the volume about 24.5 liters, the ventilation mesh. Cover at the back and sides comes from the outer film in the pattern you choose. It fits on a shelf or dresser 25 cm deep.

For young leopard and fat-tailed geckos, the free floor means room for three hides: warm, cool and humid. The 28 cm height allows a young crested gecko a few branches and a plant. A small corn snake spends its first months here, before moving to a longer terrarium. Smooth glass is easy to wash, which is practical with juveniles that are fed often.

If you do want relief, the same format with a background exists as the 35x25x30 +3D. We glue the smooth glass panels by hand in our workshop in Novi Sad, and you choose the film for them from 34 patterns. Other sizes in this format are built in 7 to 14 days and shipped by courier throughout Serbia.
